mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, which leads to increased real income and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in a quarter signals a strengthening economy, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 1% in a quarter.
